name: Kamui
source:
Mysterious demon-looking guy, who helps Rouga and some other leaders but hides a lot of secretes.

[spoiler]  Antagonist of the story. Kamui was [url=/c371]Kunnagi[/url]'s older brother. But one day he tried to awake demon blood of Tenro family. This incident lead to Kunnagi's current state and created Hell hole. Kamui was killed by [url=/c369]Gou Zanma[/url] and his current self is just merer body, possesed by demon. [/spoiler]
